package answer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// ListStudentAnswers lists attempts for task and user.
type ListStudentAnswers struct {
	Answers repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
}

// Handle returns attempts.
func (uc ListStudentAnswers) Handle(ctx context.Context, taskID, userID string) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	return uc.Answers.ListForTaskAndStudent(ctx, taskID, userID)
}
